geometryVersions.notes:
1945~1963년 서뉴기니 행정권 이전 전. 현행 인도네시아 264개 폴리곤 가운데 같은 Natural Earth 5.1.1 파푸아·서파푸아 행정구역과 일치하는 25개 섬 구성요소를 제외한 근사 형상. 1945~1949 독립전쟁 기간의 실제 통제경계까지 복원한 자료는 아님.
Display correction 2026-11-10: all 450 explicitly omitted approved modern IDN components are restored with exact donor coordinates. Existing pre-1963 West New Guinea exclusion and other coordinates remain unchanged; complete modern-scope equivalence is not yet claimed.
Partial display update prepared 2026-11-10: Kelang, Obilatu, Saparua, Makian, Tidore and Tufure use six exact whole approved modern components, identified by official names and complete connected landmass correspondence. All other 811 current components, including all existing 618 modern components and 450 restored omissions, are preserved. The other 188 broad candidate groups remain pending and unchanged. West New Guinea membership for all 2,962 modern components lacking NE correspondence is not settled; complete modern-minus-Papua scope is not claimed.
Further partial display update prepared 2026-11-10: 20 independently reviewed retained NE islands use exact whole approved modern components. All other 797 components, existing 624 modern components, restored 450, and six earlier reviewed replacements are preserved. Six questioned groups NE235/238/239/240/242/243 remain unchanged. Full West New Guinea membership for 2962 unmatched components remains unresolved; no complete-modern-scope claim.
